items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Henry would come in and sub for Tyree and that’s how I got to know him. We got this job... That was 1957 with J.J.

ctx.x: So that was four sisters. How many brothers did you have?
Hank, Henry, and Thaddeus, and Paul, and Tom, and Elvin.
And the brother that passed what was his name?
